entities.name: Notification procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the network to notify the UE, involving NOTIFICATION message transmission and timer T3565 management.

entities.name: NOTIFICATION message
entities.description: Message sent by the network to initiate the notification procedure, triggering UE actions based on access type and UE state.

entities.name: NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message
entities.description: Message sent by the UE in response to NOTIFICATION when unable to initiate service request or registration procedures over 3GPP access.

entities.name: Timer T3565
entities.description: Timer started by the network when sending NOTIFICATION message, stopped upon receiving UE response.

entities.name: Timer T3346
entities.description: Timer stopped by the UE upon reception of NOTIFICATION message if running.

entities.name: Service request procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE upon NOTIFICATION reception to request service establishment over 3GPP access.

entities.name: Registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update
entities.description: Procedure initiated by the UE for registration updates over 3GPP access when in specific states.

entities.name: PDU session status information element
entities.description: IE included in NOTIFICATION RESPONSE to indicate PDU session status and local release information.

entities.name: UE in 5GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state
entities.description: Condition where UE is registered with normal service capability over 3GPP access.

entities.name: UE in 5GMM-IDLE mode without suspend indication
entities.description: Condition where UE is in idle mode without suspension indication.

entities.name: Control plane CIoT 5GS optimization not used
entities.description: Condition where UE does not use control plane CIoT 5GS optimization.

entities.name: Local release of PDU sessions and user plane resources
entities.description: Behavior where UE locally releases single access PDU sessions and 3GPP access user plane resources of MA PDU sessions.

relations.description: Notification procedure includes sending NOTIFICATION message.
Network starts timer T3565 when initiating notification procedure.
UE stops timer T3346 upon reception of NOTIFICATION message if running.
NOTIFICATION message triggers UE to initiate service request procedure under specific conditions.
NOTIFICATION message triggers UE to initiate registration procedure under specific conditions.
Service request procedure requires UE to be in 5GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE or similar states.
Service request procedure requires UE to be in 5GMM-IDLE mode without suspend indication.
Service request procedure initiation is guarded by condition that control plane CIoT optimization is not used.
NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message contains PDU session status IE to indicate session status and local release.
NOTIFICATION RESPONSE message establishes that local release of PDU sessions and user plane resources was performed.
